title: One unmistakable focal point per view
content: Every viewport should have one element that is clearly most important (usually the h1 + primary CTA). Establish hierarchy with size and weight contrast between levels (at least 1.25x steps), not with colour alone.

title: Use a spacing scale, not ad-hoc values
content: Define 5-7 spacing tokens (e.g. 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2.5, 4, 6rem) and use only those. Section padding should be generous and consistent; inconsistent gaps are the most common tell of template work.

title: Two families, one modular scale
content: Use at most two type families. Body text 16-18px with 1.5-1.7 line-height and a 45-75 character measure. Headings follow a modular scale; do not invent one-off font sizes per section.

title: Local service customers want the next step immediately
content: Homeowners with a broken system want to call or book fast: phone and booking CTA visible above the fold on mobile, service area stated plainly, what happens on a visit explained. Proof (licences, reviews) only when the client supplies it.

title: Placeholders instead of invented facts
content: Unknown business facts are written as [[PLACEHOLDER: description]] and listed in the handoff. Never invent phone numbers, addresses, years in business, ratings, reviews, awards or statistics.

title: Static-first project structure for marketing sites
content: Preferred structure: index.html and one HTML file per page at the root, styles.css, main.js (deferred), assets/{images,icons,fonts}, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, docs/HANDOFF.md. Use a framework only when requirements need client-side state or a CMS.

title: Approved libraries
content: Plain HTML/CSS/JS by default. Three.js (ES module build, lazy-loaded) for justified 3D. No jQuery, no UI kits for marketing sites, no animation libraries when CSS transitions suffice. Self-host fonts or use system stacks.

title: Mobile menu toggles that never expand
content: Common defect: the nav is hidden below 768px but the toggle button lacks aria-controls/aria-expanded wiring or the JS targets the wrong id. Always toggle aria-expanded and a class on the controlled element, and test at 375px.

title: Horizontal overflow from fixed widths
content: Fixed pixel widths, long unbroken strings and 100vw elements cause horizontal scrolling on mobile. Use max-width:100%, minmax() in grids and overflow-wrap:anywhere for long tokens; never paper over it with overflow-x:hidden on body.

title: On-page SEO baseline
content: Unique title (30-60 chars) and description (70-160) per page, one h1, logical headings, canonical, Open Graph title/description, valid JSON-LD of the right schema.org type, sitemap.xml and robots.txt, descriptive internal anchor text.

title: Accessibility baseline
content: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast for all text, visible :focus-visible styles, labels for every control, alt text for meaningful images (empty alt for decorative), landmarks (header/nav/main/footer), skip link, prefers-reduced-motion honoured, tap targets >= 44px.

title: Performance budget for marketing sites
content: Target LCP <= 2.5s and CLS <= 0.1 on mid-range mobile. Width/height on images, loading=lazy below the fold, defer scripts, no render-blocking third parties, compress images to WebP/AVIF, keep total JS small.

title: Evidence beats opinion in reviews
content: Review findings must cite evidence (tool output, selector, viewport, screenshot) and a concrete fix. Unevidenced or duplicate findings are rejected in triage.
